seo.title: Station
seo.description: Splice Station is the control plane. Orchestrate agents, enforce gates, track evidence, and keep humans in control of AI operations.

sections.headline: The control plane for AI operations.
sections.body: Station orchestrates agents, enforces gates, tracks evidence, and keeps humans in control.

points.title: Run your agents
points.body: Station orchestrates agent execution. Define workflows, set triggers, monitor runs.

points.title: Enforce approval gates
points.body: Gates block until approved. Automated checks, human reviews, or both. Nothing proceeds without passing.

points.title: Track decisions and artifacts
points.body: Every decision has an owner. Every artifact is versioned. Evidence is required, not optional.

points.title: Human/Agent mode views
points.body: See what the agents see. Human mode shows outcomes; Agent mode shows capabilities and schemas.

options.description: You run Station on your infrastructure. Full control.

seo.title: Security
seo.description: Security-first AI deployment. Access controls, audit trails, compliance alignment, and responsible data handling.

sections.headline: Security is not optional.
sections.body: AI systems require rigorous controls. We build with security from the start, not as an afterthought.

principles.name: Access controls
principles.body: Role-based access. Principle of least privilege. Every permission is explicit.

principles.name: Audit trails
principles.body: Every action is logged. Every decision is traceable. Nothing happens without a record.

principles.name: Compliance alignment
principles.body: We work within your compliance requirements. SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA-aligned deployments.

principles.name: Data handling
principles.body: Your data stays under your control. We define data boundaries before work begins.

principles.name: Gate enforcement
principles.body: Critical operations require approval. Gates block until conditions are met.

principles.name: Evidence requirements
principles.body: Decisions require evidence. Artifacts are versioned. The audit trail is the proof.

sections.headline: Need a security review?
sections.body: Our Hardening service evaluates your AI deployments for security and compliance.

seo.title: FAQ
seo.description: Frequently asked questions about Splice Works services, Station, security, and engagements.

sections.headline: Common questions.
sections.body: Answers to questions we hear most often.

questions.q: How long does an engagement take?
questions.a: Depends on the service. Assessments are 2-4 weeks. Delivery projects are 4-12 weeks. Operations is ongoing.

questions.q: Do you work with specific industries?
questions.a: We work with organizations that need AI systems deployed responsibly. Industry matters less than the problem you are solving.

questions.q: What if we already have AI systems running?
questions.a: Start with a Hardening engagement. We will assess what you have and identify security and compliance gaps.
Station is the control plane for AI operations. It orchestrates agents, enforces gates, and tracks evidence.
Yes. Hosted, self-hosted, or hybrid deployments are all supported.

questions.q: Does Station work with existing agent frameworks?
questions.a: Station is framework-agnostic. It orchestrates agents regardless of how they are built.
Hosted Station is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Self-hosted deployments inherit your compliance posture.
Your data stays under your control. We define data boundaries before work begins.
Self-hosted Station can run in air-gapped environments.
Start with a conversation. Tell us what you want to change and we will map next steps.
Engagements are scoped and priced after an initial conversation. No generic rate cards.

questions.q: Can we start with a small pilot?
questions.a: Yes. Many engagements start with a focused Assessment before expanding.
